name: memory-retrieval
description: Self-contained hybrid (BM25 + local-vector) retrieval over file-based agent memory. node:sqlite (zero-dep) + FTS5/BM25 + local transformers.js embeddings + RRF fusion + a proactive UserPromptSubmit hook + an eval harness. A plain `pnpm install` keeps the local embedder self-contained (this directory is its own pnpm workspace root) — drop the directory into any repo and point MEMORY_DIR at its memory/.
